name: Faustina Yarathingal
summary: Faustina Yarathingal is a full-stack developer and forensic-science student in Mumbai. She builds product UI, realtime systems, and AI-assisted tools, and brings a forensic habit of checking evidence before drawing conclusions. She is studying B.Sc. (Hons.) Data Science and AI at IIT Guwahati and completed a diploma in Forensic Science and Criminal Law at St. Xavier's College.

education.program: Diploma in Forensic Science and Criminal Law

experience.title: Forensic Science Intern
experience.summary: Practical forensic work across fingerprints, questioned documents, digital and cyber forensics, and crime scene examination, including court and traffic-police visits.

projects.name: Dossier
projects.description: This assistant. A GPT-style portfolio chatbot: unlimited answers about Faustina from a structured source, plus capped general questions through Groq. Chats persist in the browser. No visitor sign-in.

projects.name: Mini Docs
projects.description: A real-time collaborative editor. Multiple people can write in the same file at once, with live cursors, presence, typing indicators, theming, and multi-document support.

projects.name: FocusFlow Landing
projects.description: A product landing page with a working focus timer in the hero (25 / 15 / 5). Local-only persistence, typography-led layout, and a night-desk visual system.

projects.name: TaskNest
projects.description: A local-first daily planner. Today is the default view; inbox is capture, upcoming is dated work, archive is done. Built as a product, not a generic todo CRUD list.

projects.name: Atmo
projects.description: A weather product with a server-only BFF so the browser never talks to the weather provider. City search, geolocation, °C/°F, hourly and 7-day outlook, and an atmosphere that follows the sky.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.description: A responsive personal site for projects, skills, and background. Built so a recruiter can scan the work quickly without losing the details.
